segments.name: High-Value Loyal Champions
segments.description: Affluent professionals purchasing groceries, organic perishables, and specialty goods with minimal coupon usage.
recommendations: Launch 'PulseBlack VIP' subscription for zero-fee scheduled delivery.
Recommend high-margin artisanal & private-label additions during checkout.
Priority 8-minute dispatch guarantee to lock retention.

segments.name: Frequent Convenience Seekers
segments.description: Young urban households ordering emergency supplies, daily dairy, snacks, and personal care.
recommendations: Incentivize multi-pack basket building to lift AOV from ₹385 to ₹450+.
Introduce 'Add before rider leaves' impulse tray (+₹65 per basket).

segments.name: Discount-Sensitive Bargain Hunters
segments.description: Users who only place orders when given 35%+ voucher codes or flat ₹100 off promotions.
recommendations: Eliminate flat discount codes on carts below ₹499.
Shift subsidies from instant cash discounts to locked store credits valid in 7 days.
Add ₹25 surge delivery fee on sub-₹200 single item orders.

segments.name: Dormant & Churn-Risk Users
segments.description: Users who have not ordered in > 35 days after an initial trial or onboarding cycle.
recommendations: Automated WhatsApp push for high-repeat staples (Milk/Eggs replenishment).
Targeted private-label sample gift voucher instead of margin-eroding generic coupons.
